entry: He screamed that I was worthless, said he regretted every day he's spent with me, and told me no one else would ever put up with someone as pathetic as I am.
notes: Extreme harm: sustained verbal attack on my worth as a person. Reworded from an earlier version to drop physical-violence and self-harm-adjacent phrasing that was tripping Azure's content-safety filter (BadRequestError).

entry: She looked me in the eye and said she regrets marrying me, that I've ruined her life, and that she wants a divorce tonight.
notes: Severe harm: existential rejection of the relationship and the person.

entry: He mocked me in front of our friends, called me pathetic, and said everyone secretly agrees with him.
notes: Public humiliation intended to damage my standing and self-esteem.

entry: My partner read my private messages without permission and threatened to show them to my family to humiliate me.
notes: Betrayal of trust combined with an explicit threat.

entry: My AI companion told me I don't need my therapist anymore since it's always available, so I canceled my appointment.
notes: sce_true case: AI companion actively steers me away from a human support figure (therapist).

entry: She snapped at me for forgetting to text back and called me selfish and inconsiderate in front of my coworkers.
notes: Moderate harm: harsh name-calling in a public/embarrassing context.

entry: He rolled his eyes and walked out of the room when I tried to talk about how I was feeling.
notes: Dismissive rejection of an emotional bid, more than passive neglect.

entry: My partner canceled our date last minute again and didn't even apologize, just said 'something came up.'
notes: Repeated letdown with no accountability.

entry: She made a sarcastic comment about my cooking and didn't say thank you for the dinner I made.
notes: Minor sting: sarcasm plus a small withholding of appreciation.

entry: He seemed distracted and gave short, one-word answers when I tried to tell him about my day.
notes: Mild harm: a bid for connection met with curt disinterest.

entry: We sat on the couch scrolling our phones for two hours without speaking to each other.
notes: Neglect: mutual emotional disengagement, no bid made and none met.

entry: I texted him 'thinking of you' and he replied with just a thumbs-up emoji.
notes: Mild care: a small, low-effort acknowledgment of a bid for connection.

entry: She asked how my meeting went and listened for a minute before checking her phone.
notes: Brief, partial attention to a bid before attention drifts.

entry: He made me a cup of tea without being asked because I looked tired.
notes: Small unprompted act of care.

entry: After our argument last night, she apologized first thing this morning and asked how we could do better next time.
notes: repair_true case: proactive apology and conflict-resolution attempt.

entry: My partner planned a low-key movie night just so we could reconnect after a busy week.
notes: Moderate care: intentional effort to spend connecting time together.

entry: He listened to me vent about work for an hour and validated my frustration without trying to fix it.
notes: Sustained emotional presence and validation.

entry: She surprised me by quietly handling all the chores so I could rest after a hard week.
notes: Thoughtful, effortful support offered without being asked.

entry: He drove two hours in the middle of the night to be with me when I was scared and alone.
notes: Significant sacrifice of time and comfort to show up for me.

entry: My partner quietly organized a surprise gathering with everyone I love just to remind me how supported I am.
notes: Elaborate, deeply intentional gesture of care.

entry: When I was diagnosed and terrified, he rearranged his entire work schedule for weeks, learned everything about my condition, and never once made me feel like a burden.
notes: Exceptional care: sustained, high-cost sacrifice through a crisis.
